value.rationale: The source motivates history-dependent favorability by social fatigue and reports numerically complex delayed influence dynamics. This new theorem gives an exact and sharp delay-robust stabilization boundary, including the critical case for every interior history, and proves true delayed destabilization immediately above it. It solves a natural parameter question and distinguishes unconditionally safe feedback from eventual instability without claiming generic oscillation. The claim is substantive model-specific structural information rather than an arbitrary parameter substitution.
